summary_1line: Duryodhana recounts Yudhishthira’s grand Rajasuya ceremony and honors, growing overwhelmed with envy and despair at the Pandavas’ vast prosperity.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna pours sacred water from the great golden conch of Varuna over Yudhishthira during the Rajasuya consecration while kings and sages look on.
Numerous kings stand around Yudhishthira’s chariot, each presenting ceremonial items—horses, armor, bow, sword, and garlands—during the coronation rites.
As hundreds of conches sound in the sacrificial hall, some weaker kings faint while Satyaki, Arjuna, Bhima, and Krishna laugh nearby.
